_comment: Client registry for JWT mode (MCP_AUTH_MODE=jwt). Non-secret. One entry per client_id your token service issues tokens to. Client IDs and token scope names below are PLACEHOLDERS: replace with your real ones. Tenants come from config/access.json.

scope_map._comment: token scope string -> server permission. Token scopes not listed here are ignored (fail closed).

care-agent-internal.description: Internal care agent. Acts for ONE customer per request, given in the X-Customer-Account-Id header set by the agent application (never by the model).

northwind-portal.description: Partner portal bound to its own accounts (tenant-b). Customer header is ignored.
